databases.empty: There are no databases in the data folder yet.
dbstatus.help.outdated: Schema versions below 5 have no upgrade path. Open the file in a current XCA first.
dbstatus.help.newer: Written by a newer XCA than this version of go-ca supports.
dbstatus.help.legacy: Pre-2.0 XCA format. Convert it with a current XCA first.
dblogin.error.ratelimit: Too many failed attempts for this database. Wait a minute and try again.
dblogin.error.locked: This database is in use by another go-ca process.

cert.heading: Certificate
ca.heading: CA properties
key.heading: Key
keycheck.ok: The private key decrypts and matches the public key.
keycheck.mismatch: The private key decrypts but does not match the public key.
keycheck.error: The private key could not be read.
keycheck.nokey: This key has no private part.
keycheck.token: The private key is on a security token, which go-ca does not access.

ext.heading: Extensions
fp.heading: Fingerprints
options.title: Options
options.heading: Options
options.intro: These settings are stored in the database and shared with desktop XCA.
error.title: Error
error.internal: Something went wrong. Details are in the server log.
dbstatus.help.upgradable: Opening it first saves a backup, then upgrades it to schema 8 as XCA 2.7 and later do. XCA 2.6 can still open the upgraded file.
dblogin.error.upgrade: The database could not be upgraded. It was left unchanged; details are in the server log.
create.heading: New database
create.name: Name
create.namehelp: Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore; .xdb is added.
create.error.name: Invalid name. Use up to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
create.error.exists: A database with this name already exists.
create.error.failed: The database could not be created. Details are in the server log.
import.heading: Import a database
import.help: Up to %d MB. The file is checked before it is stored; its password is only needed to open it.
import.error.toolarge: The file is larger than the upload limit.
import.error.legacy: This is a pre-2.0 XCA database. Convert it with a current XCA first.
import.error.invalid: This is not a valid XCA database.
import.error.newer: This database was written by a newer XCA than go-ca supports.
import.error.outdated: This database uses a schema older than 5, which has no upgrade path.
import.error.failed: The import failed. Details are in the server log.
actions.heading: Actions
actions.issue: Issue a certificate with this CA
actions.delete.warn.key: The key is removed from the database. Certificates and requests that use it remain, without a private key.
actions.delete.warn.cert: The certificate is removed. Certificates it issued remain and are linked to another issuer if one exists; its revocation entries are removed.
actions.delete.warn.request: The certificate signing request is removed.
item.error.noname: The internal name must not be empty.
item.error.extract: The public key could not be extracted; it may already be in the database.
item.error.keypass: This action needs the key's own password.
item.error.torequest: The request could not be created. Details are in the server log.
keypw.heading: Key password
keypw.help: A key with its own password asks for it every time it is used. Resetting protects it with the database password again.
keypw.error.mismatch: The new passwords do not match or are empty.
keypw.error.current: The current key password is wrong.
dbpw.title: Database password
dbpw.heading: Change the database password
dbpw.intro: All keys protected by the database password are re-encrypted with the new one. A backup is saved first. Other sessions on this database are closed.
dbpw.error.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
newkey.title: New key
newkey.heading: New key
newkey.help: RSA keys of 4096 bits or more take a few seconds. DSA and other curves cannot be generated by go-ca.
newkey.error.input: Enter a name and choose a key type.
editor.reqsubject: Keep the subject of the request
editor.subject: Subject
editor.subjecthelp: When a request is selected and its subject is kept, these fields are ignored.
editor.keyhelp: A new key gets the internal name. Unused keys are listed first. The key password is only needed for keys with their own password.
editor.syntaxhelp: Lists use OpenSSL syntax, separated by commas: DNS:, IP:, email:, URI:, RID:. DNS:copycn copies the common name, email:copy the e-mail address.
editor.error.keypass: A key with its own password is involved. Enter its password.
editor.error.mandatory: The mandatory subject entry %s is empty.
item.notice.revoked: The certificate was revoked. It appears on the next CRL.
ca.error.revoke: The certificate could not be revoked. Details are in the server log.
ca.error.properties: Invalid CA properties: the CRL interval must be between 1 and 36500 days.
rev.title: Revocations
rev.heading: Revocations of %s
rev.help: Serials that are not in the database can be revoked too. Editing keeps the revocation date. Leave the date empty for no invalidity date.
rev.error.input: The revocation could not be saved: check the serial number and the date.
crlgen.title: Generate CRL
crlgen.heading: Generate a CRL for %s

crlgen.count.zero: No certificates are revoked; the CRL will be empty.
crlgen.count.one: %d revocation will be on the CRL.
crlgen.count.other: %d revocations will be on the CRL.

crlgen.issueralt: Issuer alternative name (copy of the CA's subject alternative name)
crlgen.error.input: The CRL could not be generated: check the dates and the CRL number.
renew.title: Renew certificate
renew.heading: Renew %s
renew.help: The new certificate keeps subject, key and extensions and is signed by the same issuer. A renewed CA takes over the certificates and revocations of the old one.
renew.error.input: The certificate could not be renewed: check the dates.
editor.apply.subject: Apply subject
editor.templatesubject: Subject entries left empty are not part of the template.
editor.advancedhelp: Further extensions in OpenSSL configuration syntax, one per line, e.g. certificatePolicies, policyConstraints or OID = DER:…; sections like [alt] can be referenced with @alt. Unknown lines are reported, not ignored.
item.error.totemplate: The template could not be created. Details are in the server log.
oid.title: OID resolver
oid.heading: OID resolver
oid.help: Searches the object identifiers go-ca knows, including XCA's own additions. Names match in part.
